description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the 'git' version control system, specifically testing the pack and reverse index functionalities including creation, verification, and corruption handling.

methods.name: test_index_pack
methods.description: A helper function that removes existing pack files and invokes 'git index-pack' with specified configuration and arguments to test indexing packs with different reverse index settings.

methods.name: corrupt_rev_and_verify
methods.description: A function that corrupts specific parts of a reverse index file to test 'git fsck' detection capabilities for various corruption scenarios.
